THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Split Plate Spicy Protein Ramen Night

Heal Spot spicy protein ramen simmered in bone broth until the broth is absorbed — the protein and flavor go into the noodle instead of down the drain. Adult plate: ~430 cal / 54g protein estimated.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME15 min
COOK METHODOne pot · Stovetop · Air fryer
EST. / SERVING~430 cal | ~54g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: 1 CUP CHICKEN BONE BROTH PER RAMEN PACKAGE. Not water. Not more than 1 cup — extra broth won't absorb in 15 min.

Ingredients

ADULT

  • 2 packages Heal Spot spicy protein ramen (both included sauce packets)
  • 2 cups chicken bone broth (1 cup per package)
  • 2 Bilinski's Cajun chicken sausages (1 per adult)

ADULT (per plate)

  • 1 Heal Spot spicy protein ramen package (both packets included with the package)
  • 1 cup chicken bone broth
  • 1 Bilinski's Cajun chicken sausage (air-fried 6 min)

KID (creator's build)

  • 2 packages Maruchan chicken ramen (1 per child as served)
  • Water + seasoning packet per package directions
  • 2 regular hot dogs (1 per child as served)

Option 1

  • 1 Maruchan chicken ramen package (1 per child as served; adjust to appetite)
  • Water + Maruchan seasoning packet (package directions)
  • 1 regular hot dog (air-fried 6 min alongside the Cajun sausage)

Allergens: wheat, gluten, soy.

AT THE PAN. Two builds from the start. Adult: Heal Spot + bone broth + included sauce. Kid: Maruchan + water + seasoning packet. Sausage vs. hot dog splits at the air fryer.

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.AIR-FRY 6 MIN. Cajun chicken sausages and regular hot dogs together in the air fryer for 6 min per package guidance. Keep the two types separate — sausage is adult-only.

Adult — Spicy Protein Ramen + Cajun Sausage

  1. 2.BONE BROTH. Bring 2 cups chicken bone broth to a boil in a wide pan (1 cup per ramen package).
  2. 3.NOODLES IN. Add both Heal Spot noodle bricks. Turn and separate as they soften. Cook and toss until the broth is absorbed. Do not drain.
  3. 4.INCLUDED SAUCE ONLY. Add both included spicy sauce packets. Toss until every noodle is evenly glossy. No soy sauce, no chili oil, no chili crisp.
  4. 5.PLATE + SAUSAGE. Serve each adult with one portion of spicy protein ramen and one 6-min Bilinski's Cajun chicken sausage on top or on the side.

Kid — Maruchan + Hot Dog (Creator's Build) · Option 1

  1. 2.COOK MARUCHAN. Prepare the chicken ramen with water and its seasoning packet per package directions.
  2. 3.PLATE + HOT DOG. Bowl of chicken ramen + 1 regular hot dog on the side.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult — Spicy Protein Ramen + Cajun Sausage: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid — Maruchan + Hot Dog (Creator's Build): Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • COOK NOODLES UNTIL THE BROTH IS ABSORBED. Turn and separate as the noodles soften. Do not drain.
  • INCLUDED SPICY SAUCE PACKETS ONLY. Both of them (one per package). No soy sauce, no chili oil, no chili crisp.

If something fails

Adult noodles turned soupy: Too much broth or pulled early. Stick to 1 cup broth per package and keep tossing on medium-high until the pan is glossy, not wet.

Adult ramen tastes flat: Cooked in water instead of bone broth, or drained the pan. Rebuild with 1 cup chicken bone broth per package and let it absorb into the noodles.

Too spicy / sodium too high: Halve one of the included sauce packets. Do not add soy sauce, chili oil, or chili crisp on top — that stacks sodium and heat past what the recipe was tested at.

Bilinski's sausage came out cold in the middle: 6 min is the tested air-fry time. If the casing looks pale, add 1-2 min. Check with an instant-read thermometer to 165 F.

Kid rejected the plate: Kid side is Maruchan + regular hot dog by design — no Cajun sausage, no spicy sauce. If they still push back, cut the hot dog into coins and keep the noodles plain.

Storage and reheating

Store: Best fresh. Ramen doesn't store well — cooked noodles soften quickly in the fridge and lose the glossy coat.

Reheat: Don't reheat. It's a 15-minute dinner from scratch — make fresh each time.

Lasts: Eat same night.

~430 cal | ~54g protein.

Brands I use

Heal Spot
Spicy Protein Ramen
The adult noodle. Absorbs 1 cup of chicken bone broth to lock in protein and umami; the included spicy sauce is the intended flavor identity. Do not add soy, chili oil, or chili crisp.
Bilinski's
Organic Cajun Chicken Sausage
6-min air-fry, adult-only protein topper. Cajun seasoning stacks cleanly on the spicy noodle base without overloading heat. Clean ingredient panel.
Kirkland / any brand
Chicken Bone Broth
1 cup per ramen package — replaces water, adds protein and depth that absorbs into the noodles. Any chicken bone broth works.
Maruchan
Chicken Ramen
The kid noodle. Familiar, fast, cooked per package with water + seasoning. Zero adaptation on the kid side.
